title: Demonstrators march in Basel against violence against women
seoTitle: Basel march against violence against women

tea.why: People gathered and marched on the international day against violence against women.
tea.want: To protest against violence against women.
tea.changed: Nov 26: Police detained five people following an unauthorized march in Basel.

summary: On Wednesday evening, November 26, 2026, people first gathered for an authorized rally at the Marktplatz in Basel in connection with the international day against violence against women. At 18:00, an approved stationary gathering took place before an unpermitted march formed at 19:00, drawing between 200 and 300 participants through the city center. According to the police, participants ignited pyrotechnic devices and caused property damage by spray-painting and posting flyers on various building facades and shop windows, which also disrupted tram traffic. The march dispersed at Theodorskirchplatz at approximately 20:35. Authorities reported that a specialized civil engineering team swiftly cleaned up the graffiti and posters, while the cantonal police detained five individuals suspected of involvement in the property damage for further reporting to the public prosecutor's office.
response: According to the Basel police, officers monitored the demonstration, detained five individuals suspected of property damage for reporting to the public prosecutor, and deployed a civil engineering cleanup team to remove graffiti and posters immediately after the event.

updates.text: An unpermitted demonstration drew up to 300 people through downtown Basel following an authorized rally.
Police reported property damage including spray-painted facades and shop windows, along with the use of pyrotechnics.
The demonstration dispersed at Theodorskirchplatz at 20:35, and authorities detained five individuals in connection with property damage.
